properties.name: WHAT WORKED (dev_storyflow, 2026-09-27): `search_design` over every type found a user ruling filed as a Decision, Requirement or Constraint where a DesignRule was expected, and that stopped duplicates
properties.statement: Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (session 62995724, migrating 71 memory files into the design): "`search_design` found existing coverage across types (a user ruling I expected as a DesignRule was a Decision, a Requirement or a Constraint) — searching all types, not just rules, is what stopped duplicates." What must not regress: an unscoped search ranks every node type together. The same entry names the gap next to it (no bulk form for 71 items), triaged separately.
